missing_fields: The source does not give the oleylamine or octenoic-acid double-bond position/isomer composition.
The exact batch linkage between this recipe and the typical size-statistics passage is qualified as general context.
Matched Supporting Information is not admitted/read in this extraction scope.
No atomically refined specimen-specific CIF or coordinate file is supplied by this source.
No optical/electrical property measurement is reported in the reviewed main article.
conflicts: The source prints Cu(acac)2 as 0.13 g (1 mmol); retain both reported values and flag their mass/amount consistency for audit rather than correcting either.
Typical CuS diameter and thickness use different particle counts (418 and 358); the exact sample/batch identity is not stated beyond the adjacent typical-sample context.

The article compares 6:1 and 12:1 OLA:OA outcomes (size distribution, yield, phase) across text and separate figure contexts; the comparison does not establish a single physical batch correspondence between Figure 4 and Figure 5.
